description: dc-specs: a short note at session start in repos that use dc-specs (have specs/config.yaml). Silent everywhere else. Turn off with DC_SPECS_SESSION_NOTE=off.

hooks.command: for p in python3 python py; do "$p" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/dcspecs.py" session-context </dev/null 2>/dev/null && break; done; exit 0
